newsitem.title: USA: Uroquest drops price range for IPO.
newsitem.headline: Uroquest drops price range for IPO.

text.p: Uroquest Inc has dropped the estimated price range for shares to be offered in its initial public offering, according to regulatory documents filed Tuesday.
Uroquest, which makes products used to diagnose and manage urological disorders, plans to offer the shares in a range of $8 to $10 each. It had previously filed for a range of $11 to $13.
The company will offer 3.35 million shares. Dillon Read & Co Inc is the lead underwriter of the offering, which is expected in the middle of October.
The company plans to trade on Nasdaq under the symbol UROQ.O.
